Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), metabolic acidosis (low pH, normal pCO₂, normal bicarbonate), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, mild monocytosis and basophilia, low serum protein, elevated creatinine (suggesting renal impairment), and elevated alkaline phosphatase.
